title: Mahasu Devta Temple

buildingCutout.basis: Only the two contiguous main temple roof controls replace mapped buildings inside the Hanol site.

terrainReference.basis: Independent original relief in the open court south of the temple, clear of the roof footprint.

mapIdentity.provider: Native OpenStreetMap named Hanol temple compound and aligned Overture building geometry.
mapIdentity.scope: Two contiguous native roof traces in the named temple compound control the main sanctum and hall. Their arrangement matches the photographed series of roofs at the north edge of the southern courtyard.

note: The Indian National Monuments Authority documents stone and timber construction, a linear sequence of buildings, triple and paired roofs with slate and carved wood, and small Nagara stone shrines in the court.
